description: Delete an obsolete persistent working-memory doc under YOUR agent_id to free up the 20-doc per-agent cap after a sprint finishes. Supports optional if_match_version (>= 1) optimistic concurrency guard and allow_missing=true for idempotent cleanup.

allow_missing.description: When true, return { ok: true, deleted: false } instead of an error if the note is already absent

if_match_version.description: Optional CAS guard: delete only if stored note matches this exact version

name.description: Memory doc name/slug to delete (1..64 safe chars)

name: delete_memory
